name: Ejima Shikiko
source:
"Unbelievable, There's actually somebody that would disobey me."

The protagonist's classmate, she is also an 'Oni's Bride'.
She aims to become the 'Bride of the Onigashira', so she treats the protagonist as an obstacle.
